huntBeats.text: "Tend the hurt, stretch the food, or hunt it back — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
📢 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!" (Hunt an animal today for a reward.)
👁 It hears you coming mid-wingbeat — in the air, you don't catch it. Hunt it roosting at dawn, or wait for the water it must come down to.

Deeper knowledge: Muscadine Grapes. Uses: sugar, resveratrol. Leaves are edible (like grape leaves). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: thick-skinned wild grapes, sweet-tart; bait: fallen fruit baits traps well.
📖 LEARNED: Scarecrow (Level 1). You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.
🔍 Theo crouches over big arrowhead leaves on long stalks rising from muddy water, with starchy corms below, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)
📖 Nathan is showing Sari the broad leaves standing tall above still water on stiff stalks — where it grows, what's safe to eat.

📺 TRIAL ACCEPTED: Trial of the Long Stalk. "Excellent choice. We simulated all three. This one had the best lighting."
🏹 TRIUMPH: you read the ground like a letter — bent grass, a print, the wind in your face. The kill is clean, quick, and kind. The System replays it eleven times.
(The village feasts tonight: +600 kcal to the pantry. The watchers will remember the stalk.)

◈ The System names Zoltan: Stalker of the Apex Predator. The village repeats it at the fire.
★ IDENTIFIED: Sweet Manioc. Manioc. Tall stalks, hand-shaped leaves, thick roots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Two eyes, forward-facing, unblinking. No wingsound. Owls don't make sound when they hunt — that's the problem.

Somewhere, something that hunts you decides not to. Look at Zoltan. Look at what the light does around them now. Zoltan is The Apex Predator — The Hunt Made Flesh. Antlered silhouette, clawed hands, amber predator eyes that catch the light. Tawny and red — the beast you hunted, wearing you.

Too heavy for the rest — left where it lies: Good Boots x1, Gland sac x1, Sinew cord x1, Muscadine Grapes x6, Phase sling x1, Pawpaw x9, Phase blade x1, Alien carapace x1, Good Boots x1, Hunting spear x1.
📯 MUSTER — scouts report The Nielsen hunting near Haven, and it is beyond us. Everyone inside. No one walks the treeline alone — the garden crews double up, the hunters stand down. We outlast it.

⛔ THE NIELSEN does not notice you the way prey notices a hunter. It notices you the way weather notices a field. You cannot face this alone — sound the call, muster 12 allied blades (you have 0). This is not courage. This is arithmetic.
